scripts.test:unit: npm run test:target:js && npm run test:unit:backend && npm run test:unit:frontend
scripts.test:unit:backend: cd backend && AFTERGLOW_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 uv run python -m pytest tests/ -v --ignore=tests/integration --ignore=tests/contracts -m "not db and not contract"
scripts.test:live: cd backend && AFTERGLOW_ALLOW_INSECURE=1 uv run python -m pytest tests/integration -v
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract && npm run test:functional
scripts.test:gate: npm run docs:check && npm run test:all && npm run lint:backend
scripts.test:orchestration: node --test scripts/test-target.test.js scripts/test-db.test.js scripts/github-actions-contract.test.js && node scripts/test-target.js --validate
scripts.test:target:js: npm run test:orchestration && npm run test:kolla:contract
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:backend:fix: cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && git add backend/pyproject.toml backend/uv.lock frontend/package.json package.json
